description: Source code for pack object management in a Git-like version control system, including functions for preparing, releasing, removing redundant packs, and handling pack files.

classes.name: generated_pack
classes.description: Represents a set of temporary files associated with a generated pack.

methods.name: prepare_pack_objects
methods.description: Prepares command arguments for packing objects based on provided args.

methods.name: pack_objects_args_release
methods.description: Releases memory allocated for pack objects arguments.

methods.name: repack_remove_redundant_pack
methods.description: Removes redundant pack files from the repository.

methods.name: write_pack_opts_pack_prefix
methods.description: Determines the pack prefix based on options.

methods.name: write_pack_opts_is_local
methods.description: Checks if the pack destination is local.

methods.name: finish_pack_objects_cmd
methods.description: Finalizes the pack-objects command and processes its output.

methods.name: existing_packs_collect
methods.description: Collects and categorizes existing packs in the repository.

methods.name: existing_packs_has_non_kept
methods.description: Checks if there are non-kept or cruft packs.

methods.name: existing_pack_mark_for_deletion
methods.description: Marks a pack for deletion.

methods.name: existing_pack_unmark_for_deletion
methods.description: Unmarks a pack for deletion.

methods.name: existing_pack_is_marked_for_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a pack is marked for deletion.

methods.name: existing_packs_mark_retained
methods.description: Marks a pack as retained.

methods.name: existing_pack_is_retained
methods.description: Checks if a pack is marked as retained.

methods.name: existing_packs_mark_for_deletion_1
methods.description: Marks packs for deletion based on criteria.

methods.name: existing_packs_retain_cruft
methods.description: Marks a cruft pack as retained.

methods.name: existing_packs_mark_for_deletion
methods.description: Marks multiple packs for deletion.

methods.name: existing_packs_remove_redundant
methods.description: Removes redundant packs from the repository.

methods.name: existing_packs_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with existing packs.

methods.name: generated_pack_populate
methods.description: Populates a generated pack structure with existing pack files.

methods.name: generated_pack_has_ext
methods.description: Checks if a generated pack has a specific extension.

methods.name: generated_pack_install
methods.description: Installs a generated pack into the repository.
